verdict.rationale: Notion runs a Marketplace where security-reviewed public connections are listed and discoverable to all users. Its integrations directory shows named third-party tools including GitHub, Loom, Tableau, Mixpanel, Canva, Calendly and Sketch, which delivers the core of a PM connecting a workspace to outside tools. Missing for 10: no evidence of the marketplace's actual scale (the "thousands" of tools claim is unverified), no independent or hands-on corroboration of installing marketplace apps, and only an older community complaint about a missing GitHub integration that the current directory supersedes.
